description: Phase 5 graph HELD-OUT set, written on 2026-10-14 in M0, BEFORE any graph-answer code existed. Not used while building: run against the graph-integrated KORA exactly once, after M3 is finished, and reported as-is (first run kept, fixes recorded separately). Its Phase 4 baseline is frozen in M0 with summary numbers only; per-question baseline results are not inspected before M3 closes. Same schema as graph_dev_questions.json. Labels by Claude against data/raw. UT may add his own questions in a separate file (graph_heldout_ut_questions.json) any time before M3 closes. H02, H04 and H09 were seen during M2 development by mistake (see their notes) and are reported separately; the other 9 remain unseen.

questions.note: SEEN during M2 development (2026-10-14): Claude ran this question by mistake while checking impact answers. It revealed duplicate 'possibly related' lines (fixed generally). Report H02 separately; it no longer counts as an unseen question.

Not tuned for; the test case was removed. Report H04 separately. Original note: KG-02 states the documented reason (no standard; triaged case-by-case).
